column3: Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew names lying in My faithfulness; BSB says betray My faithfulness.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew says once, without the explicit and for all added by BSB.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew joins a witness in the sky with and; BSB places a faithful witness in apposition.
The Hebrew uses completed actions and does not explicitly add him or now as BSB does.
The Hebrew says to the earth; BSB specifies in the dust.
The Hebrew calls the strongholds a terror or ruin; BSB specifies rubble.
The Hebrew has a completed plundering verb; BSB uses present plunder.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew says turn back the sword’s edge; BSB says bent.
Close to the Hebrew.

Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew asks what my lifespan is without explicitly adding briefness as BSB does.
The Hebrew explicitly names Sheol’s hand; BSB says power.
The Hebrew has loving acts in the plural; BSB has loving devotion.
The Hebrew explicitly names my bosom and many peoples; BSB says my heart and many people.
The Hebrew names footsteps without the explicit every added by BSB.
Close to the Hebrew.
